## Flagship Engineering Projects

### 1. Deepfake Forensics & Explainable AI
- **Category**: Computer Vision & AI Forensics
- **Tech Stack**: Python, PyTorch, EfficientNet-B4, SyncNet, Grad-CAM, SHAP, FastAPI, React
- **Summary**: Multi-modal forensics engine fusing 15 detection signals with 94.2% validation accuracy. Generates visual attribution heatmaps (Grad-CAM/SHAP), lip-sync confidence scores, and automated forensic PDF reports.
- **Source**: https://github.com/saksham-dev07/Deepfake-Forensics-with-Explainable-AI
- **Demo**: https://deepforensics.vercel.app/

### 2. Natural Language App Compiler
- **Category**: Generative AI & LLM Systems
- **Tech Stack**: Node.js, JavaScript, Gemini API, Multi-pass AST
- **Summary**: 4-stage compiler-style pipeline that translates natural language prompts into validated, deployable web application code with 100% automated database schema synthesis.
- **Source**: https://github.com/saksham-dev07/NL-App-Compiler

### 3. DocPilot — Clinical Management Platform
- **Category**: Full-Stack Healthcare Platform
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Firebase, Appwrite, Gemini AI
- **Summary**: Role-based clinical platform with Gemini AI serving as an automated consultation scribe generating structured clinical notes, paired with Appwrite real-time state synchronization.
- **Source**: https://github.com/saksham-dev07/Docpilot

### 4. NexusBoard — Collaborative Canvas
- **Category**: Real-Time Distributed Systems & WebSockets
- **Tech Stack**: React, HTML5 Canvas API, WebSockets, CRDT / Delta Sync
- **Summary**: Real-time collaborative infinite canvas and whiteboard engine with sub-20ms WebSocket delta sync and 60 FPS drawing loop.
- **Source**: https://github.com/saksham-dev07/NexusBoard
